messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Tesla has not yet launched the Model S in India, so there is no official Indian price or availability at this time.  

If you’re curious about what the price might look like, you can take the U.S. MSRP (about $90,000–$100,000 for the standard Model S) and convert it to Indian rupees using the current exchange rate. For example, at an exchange rate of roughly ₹82 per U.S. dollar, that would translate to about ₹7.4 million–₹8.2 million.  

However, until Tesla officially enters the Indian market, the only reliable information is that the Model S is not available for purchase in India.
